purpose: Explain an obligation created by appearances or a prior statement.
keywords: express wishes wants obligation permission request advice
Vた / N + の + 手前
Having promised, I cannot refuse now.
I could not complain in front of the children.
Since I proposed it myself, I will see it through.
formation: Vた / N + の + 手前
restrictions: Social consistency or someone’s presence constrains the choice.
mistake: It does not mean physical space in front of something here.
